items.title: I didn't receive the reset email
items.content: Check your spam folder. If you still don't see it, try requesting another reset link. Make sure you're using the email address associated with your account.

items.title: The reset link expired
items.content: Password reset links are valid for 1 hour for security reasons. Please request a new reset link from the Request Reset tab.

items.title: I don't remember my email address
items.content: Please contact our support team for assistance in recovering your account. Have your account information ready for verification.

items.title: How do I create a strong password?
items.content: Use at least 8 characters with a mix of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters. Avoid common words or personal information.

config.text: Still having trouble? Contact our support team
